source: Christensen, Oomen & Reno, The drift burst hypothesis, Journal of Econometrics; brain/sources/prop_firm_same_day_ideas_2026-10-27.md

rule.days: NYSE cash sessions in session-calendar.v1.csv; early-close days: signals 09:15 to 11:30, flat at the session's exit minute
rule.window: a shock may be detected and an entry made only between 09:15 and 14:30 CT (entry fill minute <= 14:30)
rule.move: M(t) = close(t) - close(t-15) in ticks, t = 1-minute bar; both bars must exist and be on the same session
rule.scale: S(tod) = root mean square of M at the same minute-of-day over the previous 60 eligible sessions (point-in-time; at least 40 observations, else no signal)
rule.shock: |M(t)| >= 4 * S(tod); direction = sign(M(t)); only the first shock of the day counts
rule.news_exclusion: on FOMC statement days (pinned list) no shock may be detected and no entry made after 12:45 CT
rule.confirmation: within the 10 bars after the shock bar, the first bar whose close is against the shock (close > open after a down-shock; close < open after an up-shock); none -> no trade that day
rule.entry: open of the bar after the confirmation bar, opposite the shock; missing bar -> no trade
rule.stop: 1 tick beyond the most extreme price from the start of the 15-minute window to the confirmation bar (low for a down-shock long, high for an up-shock short); fills as in SC-FUT-0001 (stop level, or the open if a bar gaps through; touch on the entry bar counts)
rule.exit: open of the bar 60 minutes after entry, the stop, or the normal flatten (15:07 CT; early close per calendar), whichever comes first; missing exit bar -> non-evaluable
rule.costs: L3 primary; L1-L4 reported; prop simulation also at L4

benchmarks.matched_control: same day, same entry minute, same stop distance mirrored to the other side, same exit rule; random direction; 500 draws seeded [20261026, root, yyyymmdd, 4]
benchmarks.diagnostic: always fade (the strategy itself) vs always follow the shock

gates.sample_floor: if the rule produces fewer than 40 MES trades in practice, report 'too few to judge' and stop; no loosening
gates.prop_main: Topstep 50K (rules file sha256 219fab9df1fe39b02bf55fd38ec4b7e25e166f0fb54cc322ddf2768378aa31f7), frozen size 2 micros, 6-month budget (126 trading days), L3: first-account pass rate minus luck (at luck's best size) has a 90% range above 0 and median days to pass <= 126; also reported at L4
gates.workbench_supporting: vs matched control at the shock_reversal family's honesty-adjusted bar; by year, regime, cost level
gates.phase_2: payouts and net cash once built
